summary: order-dispatch achieves Grade S (94/100) as a clean Python 3.11+ FastAPI + Pydantic v2 microservice benchmark: 100% typing, import hygiene, and docstring coverage, strict acyclic 4-layer Clean Architecture, 4/4 passing offline Docker tests (85.2% line coverage, clean /healthz ASGI boot), zero declared application CVEs, and SHA-pinned OpenSSF CI governance. Live DAST and Trivy image inspection identified four concrete production hardening targets: adding OAuth2/JWT authentication on /v1/orders (CWE-306), refreshing the python:3.12.6-slim-bookworm base image into a pip-free multi-stage build with HEALTHCHECK, adding HTTP security headers and gating /openapi.json in prod, and expanding TestClient/MockTransport branch coverage from 62.5% above 80%.
